comment: The jellyfin-web 10.11.5 anchors Access Roles' web guard uses (by the kit's anchor rules), the one place their selectors are written. Kit.props embeds this file as Web.anchors.json: the kit's EmbeddedScript puts it into the ClientScript (kit.anchors, reached through Web/js/10-selectors.js), the head fragment's CSS is built from it on the server (Web/AccessRolesHead), the server accepts only these names and views in ClientHealth reports, and scripts/Test-WebAnchors.ps1 looks for them in the installed jellyfin-web. css is the primary selector, then the fallbacks. Notes cite the 10.11.5 chunk (bundle: <chunk>) and what a 10.11.5 sandbox showed.

anchors.name: drawerSettings
anchors.note: The legacy drawer's Settings link (main.jellyfin.bundle.js libraryMenu). Hidden by CSS under jfar-lock-allsettings and jfar-pending. Missing: the link stays, and the route guard still keeps the locked pages away.

anchors.name: userMenu
anchors.note: The experimental layout's MUI user menu (main.jellyfin.bundle.js, id app-user-menu, keepMounted). Missing: no aria-disabled marks or focus fix; the CSS rules match nothing.

anchors.name: userMenuButton
anchors.note: The avatar button that opens the MUI user menu (main.jellyfin.bundle.js AppUserMenu). A pointer or key press on it runs the focus fix. Missing: the fix runs only when the menu's items are marked.

anchors.name: userMenuItem
anchors.note: The MUI user menu's items (MenuItem, role menuitem). Hidden ones get aria-disabled so MenuList's arrow keys skip them, and the focus goes to the first visible one. Missing: no keyboard fix.

anchors.name: userMenuProfile
anchors.note: The MUI user menu's Profile item, the first one (main.jellyfin.bundle.js to:/userprofile?userId=). Hidden by CSS under jfar-lock-profile. Missing: it stays; the guard redirects the page.

anchors.name: userMenuSettings
anchors.note: The MUI user menu's Settings item (main.jellyfin.bundle.js to:/mypreferencesmenu). Hidden by CSS under jfar-lock-allsettings. Missing: it stays; the Settings page shows only Sign out and the note.

anchors.name: userMenuQuickConnect
anchors.note: The MUI user menu's Quick Connect item (main.jellyfin.bundle.js). Hidden by CSS under jfar-lock-quickconnect. Missing: it stays; the guard redirects the page.

anchors.name: userMenuDivider
anchors.note: The MUI user menu's first divider (main.jellyfin.bundle.js Divider), left alone at the top when Profile, Settings and Jellyfin Enhanced's entry are hidden. CSS only. Missing: a divider line shows at the top.

anchors.name: userMenuDividerNoJe
anchors.note: The same divider when Jellyfin Enhanced's cloned entry isn't in the menu (needs :has(), Chrome 105+; a variant not run on a sandbox). CSS only. Missing: a divider line shows at the top.

anchors.name: jeEntries
anchors.note: Jellyfin Enhanced's entries to its settings panel (JE's script; its menu clone has href="#", so ids). Hidden by CSS under jfar-lock-enhancedpanel; JE's saves are refused on the server. Missing: JE isn't installed or renamed them.

anchors.name: settingsPage
anchors.note: The Settings menu page (bundle: user-settings chunk, id myPreferencesMenuPage). The note goes into it. Missing: no note; the links' CSS rules match nothing and the guard still redirects.

anchors.name: settingsSignOut
anchors.note: Sign out on the Settings page (bundle: user-settings chunk, btnLogout listItem-border), the only Sign out of the TV layout. The note goes right before it. Missing: the note goes at the end of the page.

anchors.name: settingsProfileLink
anchors.note: The Settings page's Profile link (bundle: user-settings chunk, lnkUserProfile). Hidden by CSS under jfar-lock-profile. Missing: it stays; the guard redirects the page.

anchors.name: settingsDisplayLink
anchors.note: The Settings page's Display link (bundle: user-settings chunk, lnkDisplayPreferences). Hidden by CSS under jfar-lock-displaydevice only (the page stays for the layout and language). Missing: it stays; the guard redirects the page.

anchors.name: settingsHomeLink
anchors.note: The Settings page's Home screen link (bundle: user-settings chunk, lnkHomePreferences). Hidden by CSS under jfar-lock-home. Missing: it stays; the guard redirects the page.

anchors.name: settingsPlaybackLink
anchors.note: The Settings page's Playback link (bundle: user-settings chunk, lnkPlaybackPreferences). Hidden by CSS under jfar-lock-playback. Missing: it stays; the guard redirects the page.

anchors.name: settingsSubtitlesLink
anchors.note: The Settings page's Subtitles link (bundle: user-settings chunk, lnkSubtitlePreferences). Hidden by CSS under jfar-lock-subtitles. Missing: it stays; the guard redirects the page.

anchors.name: settingsControlsLink
anchors.note: The Settings page's Controls link (bundle: user-settings chunk, lnkControlsPreferences). Hidden by CSS under jfar-lock-controls. Missing: it stays; the guard redirects the page.

anchors.name: settingsQuickConnectLink
anchors.note: The Settings page's Quick Connect link (bundle: user-settings chunk, lnkQuickConnectPreferences). Hidden by CSS under jfar-lock-quickconnect. Missing: it stays; the guard redirects the page.

anchors.name: preferencePage
anchors.note: The settings pages' roots (bundle: user-* chunks; Plugin Pages' host #userPluginPreferencesPage carries the class too and hosts My Bookmarks and My Clips, so it is left out). Hidden by CSS under jfar-blocking while a locked page is redirected. Missing: a locked page may show for a frame.

anchors.name: profilePage
anchors.note: The Profile page (bundle: user-userprofile chunk). A late legacy view of a locked section is told by its page id. Missing: only the hash decides.

anchors.name: quickConnectPage
anchors.note: The Quick Connect page (bundle: quickConnect chunk). Told by its page id as profilePage is. Missing: only the hash decides.

anchors.name: displayPage
anchors.note: The Display page in both layouts (bundle: user-display-index-html and user-display-index-tsx chunks). Its Display (account) fields are disabled while visible. Missing: the fields stay enabled; the server keeps their values.

anchors.name: homeScreenPage
anchors.note: The Home screen page, whose id the Subtitles page reuses (bundle: user-home-index-html and user-subtitles-index-html chunks), so the hash decides between them. Missing: only the hash decides.

anchors.name: playbackPage
anchors.note: The Playback page (bundle: user-playback-index-html chunk). Told by its page id as profilePage is. Missing: only the hash decides.

anchors.name: controlsPage
anchors.note: The Controls page (bundle: user-controls-index-html chunk). Told by its page id as profilePage is. Missing: only the hash decides.

anchors.name: displayMissingEpisodes
anchors.note: Display (account): missing episodes, legacy then experimental (bundle: user-display-index-html, user-display-index-tsx). Disabled under jfar-lock-displayaccount. Missing: it stays enabled; the server keeps the value.

anchors.name: episodeImagesInNextUp
anchors.note: Display (account): episode images in Next Up, legacy then experimental (same chunks). Disabled under jfar-lock-displayaccount. Missing: it stays enabled; the server keeps the value.

anchors.name: dashboardTheme
anchors.note: Display (account): the dashboard theme, rendered for administrators only, to whom no lock applies (same chunks). Disabled if ever shown under the lock. Missing: the usual case.

anchors.name: homePage
anchors.note: Home's view (bundle: home chunk). Its viewshow replaces the no-libraries text. Missing: the stock text stays.

anchors.name: homeNoLibraries
anchors.note: Home's no-libraries message, AskAdminToCreateLibrary, rebuilt on every show and only when no library and no playlist is visible (bundle: 56213 chunk). Replaced for a managed user with no library. Missing: the stock text.

anchors.name: userEditorContent
anchors.note: The stock Dashboard user editor's content, profile, access, parental control and password tabs (bundle: users-profile, users-access, users-parentalcontrol, users-password chunks; on 12.4 one React page, #usersEditPage in the users-edit chunk). The admin banner goes first in it. Missing: no banner.

anchors.name: newUserContent
anchors.note: The stock Add user page's content (bundle: users-add chunk, id newUserPage). The default roles' banner goes first in it. Missing: no banner; the default roles still apply.
